snippet.title: GHOST FREQUENCY | OFFICIAL RELEASE DATE TRAILER
snippet.description:
Wishlist GHOST FREQUENCY and check out our other games on Steam:https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Serafini

Play as Mark, a veteran ghost hunter. Armed with real-world tools and guided by your partner Emily, search for your missing teammates in a haunted house filled with paranormal secrets.

Inspired by Italy’s PIT (Paranormal Investigation Team), the game uses authentic ghost-hunting tech:
🔹 EMF Detector
🔹 EVP Recorder
🔹 IR Thermal Camera

Follow us on X (Twitter)https://twitter.com/UNFOLLOW_GAME
Instagramhttps://www.instagram.com/serafiniproductions/
